senses.gloss:
जघन जघन, अस्, अम्, m. n. in the later
language always n. (probably a reduplicated form of
rt. हन्, but by some connected with जंह्), the
hinder part, the buttock, the hip and loins, the
pudenda, mons veneris; rear-guard, reserve of an
army; [cf. जङ्घा.]
—जघन-कूपक, औ, m.
du. the hollow of the loins of a handsome woman.
—जघन-गौरव, अम्, n. the weight of the
hips.
—जघन-चपला, f. a libidinous woman
(moving the hips); a woman active in dancing; a
species of the Āryā metre.
—जघन-तस्, ind.
behind, on the hinder part, after; [cf. अग्र-तस्.]
—जघनार्ध (˚न-अर्˚), अस्, m. the hinder part
(opposed to पूर्वार्ध); rear-guard, reserve of an
army.
—जघने-फला, f. the opposite-leaved fig-
tree, Ficus Oppositifolia.

जघनिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having stout hips or large
buttocks.

जघनेन, ind. behind, (with gen. or acc.) back-
wards, away from.

जघन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, hindmost, hinder, last,
latest, lowest, low, worst, vilest, vile, base, shortest,
least, least important; of low origin or rank; (अस्),
m. a Śūdra or man of the lowest class; N. of the
attendant of Mālavya, who was one of the five princes
born under particular constellations; (अम्), n. the
penis; (अम् or ए), ind. after, behind, last; जघन्ये
कृ, to leave behind, turn the back on; [cf. Hib.
deaghanach, ‘last.’]
—जघन्य-गुण-वृत्ति-स्थ,
अस्, आ, अम्, addicted to low pursuits, chiefly familiar
with the lowest of the three Guṇas.
—जघन्य-च-
पला, f. a species of the Āryā metre; [cf. जघन-
चपला.]
—जघन्य-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, last born, young-
est; low-born; (अस्), m. a younger brother; a Śūdra.
—जघन्य-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, lower, inferior.
—ज-
घन्य-तस्, ind. behind, at the back, after.
—जघन्य-
शायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, lying down last, going to bed last.

जघन्वस् जघन्वस्, वान्, घ्नुषी, वत् (fr.
rt. हन्), who or what has killed.

जघ्नि, इस्, इस्, इ, striking, killing; (इस्), m. a
weapon, offensive instrument.

जघ्निवस्, वान्, घ्नुषी, वत् (perf. part.), =
जघन्वस् above.
जघ्नु, उस्, उस्, उ, striking, beating, killing.

जघ्रि जघ्रि, इस्, इस्, इ (reduplicated form fr.
rt. घृ), Ved. pouring out, sprinkling about.

जाघनी जाघनी, f. (fr. जघन), a tail;
the thigh, leg.
